items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jacobs' as a drummer for Claude Hopkins; the interviewee does not respond to this specific mention or claim any personal connection.

ctx.x: I don't know whether it was "Remember." was so related. In your sleep you'd still be patting your foot. Anyway, it was something like that. It (unintelligible) those Yeah, those rhythm sections, Lunceford and all those bands that became prominent usually had good swinging rhythm sections.

Yeah. Well, there was another one that I liked, at one time, Claude Hopkins had a nice rhythm section, where he had -- I can't remember the drummer's name, but he was good. Jacobs, I think his name was. That was a very nice,
